_comment: Runtime data dependencies of the FFBE synthetic server. Every `producer` here is a command the SHIPPED BUNDLE can run -- if it is not, this file is wrong (docs/SIMPLER_DISTRIBUTABLE.md S6.1). No game content ships with this app.

entries.label: Decoded MST tables
entries.producer: ffbe-server prepare --apk <your FFBEWW.apk> --client-data <your client data folder>

entries.label: Decoded localized text
entries.producer: ffbe-server prepare --apk <your FFBEWW.apk> --client-data <your client data folder>

entries.label: Client CDN tree (mst/)
entries.producer: your own client dump: <app data dir>/files

entries.label: CDN overlay (patched tables + fetched packs)
entries.producer: optional -- build your own patches with the engine's tooling; without it the shipped tables are served

entries.label: TLS certs (leaf.pem / leaf.key)
entries.producer: ffbe-server prepare --apk <your FFBEWW.apk> --client-data <your client data folder>   (generates the CA + leaf in-process)
